g.text: The RK3566 application processor, one sub-sheet per IO domain or function

g.desc: The RK3566 application processor, one sub-sheet per IO domain or function

g.text: SoC: USB, PCIe, MIPI, HDMI and eDP PHYs

g.desc: SoC: USB, PCIe, MIPI, HDMI and eDP PHYs

g.text: SoC: PMU IO domains, clock, reset and SARADC

g.desc: SoC: PMU IO domains, clock, reset and SARADC

g.text: 1. Function: the RK3566 SoC (board ADR 0003), drawn as one sub-sheet per IO domain or function

g.desc: 1. Function: the RK3566 SoC (board ADR 0003), drawn as one sub-sheet per IO domain or function

g.text: (CRAFT-126): each sub-sheet holds the RK3566 units of that domain and their support parts.

g.desc: (CRAFT-126): each sub-sheet holds the RK3566 units of that domain and their support parts.

g.text: 2. Absent state: not applicable. No variant omits the SoC; another SoC is another board (RFC 0011 §3).

g.desc: 2. Absent state: not applicable. No variant omits the SoC; another SoC is another board (RFC 0011 §3).

g.text: 3. Sub-sheet IDs (blk.soc-*) are sheets of blk.soc: their parts carry Block = blk.soc-* so the

g.desc: 3. Sub-sheet IDs (blk.soc-*) are sheets of blk.soc: their parts carry Block = blk.soc-* so the

g.text: craft check can resolve them; the catalog block is blk.soc (feature-blocks spec #1).

g.desc: craft check can resolve them; the catalog block is blk.soc (feature-blocks spec #1).

g.text: 4. Constraints: PCB-I-05 (LPDDR4X), PCB-I-06 (eMMC); decoupling per RK3566 HDG 1.1 pp. 35-41.

g.desc: 4. Constraints: PCB-I-05 (LPDDR4X), PCB-I-06 (eMMC); decoupling per RK3566 HDG 1.1 pp. 35-41.
